title.narrative: IOM. Air Border Data Systems in Nigeria. 2020-2023.

description.narrative:
Building on the previous project (phase one) that laid the foundation for technical infrastructure to support the Federal Government of Nigeria to build a national data architecture, the current project also seek to facilitate faster, safer, and more reliable traveler processing at the airports. The project's objective is to enhance the rollout and implementation of the MIDAS border management information systems to capacitate Nigeria to obtain additional data on migrant stocks and flows, documenting migration patterns and trends, characteristics of migrants as well as drivers and impact of migration.
This comprehensive approach aligns with the Country’s commitment to implement border management practices that respect national sovereignty, the rule of law, obligations under international law, and the human rights of all migrants. By fostering the adoption of global best practices to manage border in an integrated, secure and coordinated manner, the country of Nigeria would be better capacitated to ensure effective and rights-based migration governance and management.
